summary: A single-player vertical slice of a 5v5 tactical shooter: full Cipher Breach matches against server-side bots on an original two-vault map, with 12 weapons, five utility items, round economy and an in-process authoritative 64 Hz simulation.
notes: Local only: no online multiplayer, matchmaking or services. Not hand-played by a human; verified by 96 headless tests and a 20-check scripted run of the production build in headless Edge. Gameplay screenshots use attract mode (?autopilot=1), where the local seat is bot-driven. The match requests fullscreen and Pointer Lock; Esc pauses.
